name: dev
description: a software change: tests first, the suite gates the test stage

stages.name: plan
stages.exit: the change, its tests and its risks are written down

stages.name: build
stages.exit: failing tests written first, then the code that makes them pass

stages.name: review
stages.exit: a second agent or the owner has read the diff; findings fixed or answered

stages.name: done
stages.exit: committed; pushed only on the owner's go
